description:
Enables ODFC containers which changes the location of some Office based data.

CAUTION: ODFC containers are designed to work with other roaming profie solutions. It is recommended to only use Profile containers when using FSLogix.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\Enabled
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
